**Teaching Assistant · Undergraduate course · Spring 2025**

**University of Tennessee, Knoxville · Instructor: Dr. Fatima T. Zahra**
:::

## Teaching contributions

I supported undergraduate students in applying statistical concepts to practical decisions, connecting classroom explanations with hands-on work during weekly applied sessions.

- Facilitated practice in **R, Excel, Stata, and generative AI**, guiding students through debugging, method selection, and a statistical consulting project.
- Developed **instructor-reviewed model solutions** and maintained Canvas discussions to support practice and feedback.
- Reinforced independent problem solving, critical evaluation, attribution, and responsible uses of generative AI.
- Supported classroom research through survey and assessment administration, documentation of GenAI engagement, and FERPA-aware handling of student interaction data.

## Connection to my research

This teaching experience connects to my work on how learners explain statistical reasoning and evaluate AI assistance. My related [Next Level Teaching Blueprint research](../../Projects/Next_Level_Teaching_Blueprint/Next_Level_Teaching_Blueprint.qmd) examines critical thinking, AI literacy, and student–AI discourse in research methods courses.
